interpretation: Execução condicional sobre a referência observada N; gate de homologação global não superado. Agregados/anuais já foram inspecionados, sem pré-registro independente ou nova amostra confirmatória.
iut: Maximum one-sided annual p in each direction. Every planned year required; insufficient years retain non-estimable family slots.

rolling.purpose: overlapping exploratory diagnostics, no test count or persistence claim from overlap

sensitivity_scope: Ten declared configurations, not a full factorial or a choice by p-value. Event mask is union of existing +/-5-session exclusions plus Light Q4; no removal of complete years. Global B3 trading-endpoint sensitivity remains pending authenticated endpoint data.
equivalence: Not tested; no economic equivalence margin chosen.
data_limitations: Five ABCB4/UGPA3 rights gaps plus two ANIM3 gaps in decade preserved. 73/74 local reviews, zero complete global histories. RENDIMENTO zero cutoff net amounts/rates operative. Cash bounds are not beta bounds. Retrospective fixed selection and survival biases remain.
family_scope: 474 per configuration, primary N_log_HAC5. Alternative configurations exploratory; no control claimed across research program or configuration selection. Common80 reuses the 117 recent directions.
